label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y pondrás la mesa desde fuera a la parójet, y la menorá frente a la mesa sobre costado del mishkán hacia el sur, y la mesa darás sobre costado norte.
spanish: Y pondrás la mesa fuera del velo, y el candelabro frente a la mesa sobre el costado del tabernáculo hacia el sur, y la mesa darás sobre el costado norte.
grammarChanges: Translated לַפָּרֹכֶת as 'velo' instead of leaving the untranslated lemma 'parójet'.
Translated הַמְּנֹרָה as 'candelabro' instead of leaving the untranslated lemma 'menorá'.
Translated הַמִּשְׁכָּן as 'tabernáculo' instead of leaving the untranslated lemma 'mishkán'.
Changed 'desde fuera a' to 'fuera de' so the Spanish reads as the locative 'outside-of' sense rather than a path.
Added the article 'el' before 'costado' in both occurrences for Spanish agreement/naturalness.
readerNote: Kept 'fuera de' as the locative outside-of reading rather than a path, and kept the article in 'hacia el sur' as grammatical smoothing required by Spanish, not licensed by a separate Hebrew token.
